propositions: CodeQL reports high-severity incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts at lines 249 and 250 in test_llm_fallback_chain.py where startswith is used to check URL prefixes instead of exact host comparison

Prefix-based URL checks allow false positives: a host sharing the endpoint as a prefix (e.g. https://fallback.test.evil.example) would pass a startswith assertion meant to verify exact endpoint origin

The test should compare parsed URL origin (scheme and netloc tuple) via urllib.parse.urlsplit for exact equality rather than substring matching to eliminate both the CodeQL alert and the assertion weakness
Endpoint constant must be single-sourced so configured and asserted values cannot drift, maintaining tolerance for normalized URLs (trailing slashes, path components) without substring semantics
